turns.text: Did you paraphrase effectively, maybe you forgot a word doesn't matter if you can explain around that word, the examiner will reward that.
turns.zh: 你有没有做到有效地转述？也许你忘了一个词，但如果你能绕着这个词解释清楚，那也没关系，考官会给你加分的。

turns.text: So in terms of grammar, when you're listening back, have you used a wide range of structures?
turns.zh: 那么从语法方面来说，你回听的时候，有没有用到多种不同的结构？

turns.text: Have you got all the tenses in there relative clauses?
turns.zh: 你有没有把所有的时态都用上，比如关系从句？

turns.text: Are your sentences frequently error free?
turns.zh: 你的句子是不是经常没有错误？

turns.text: This is something your one on one tutorial will be really helpful for it's hard sometimes to pick up your own errors.
turns.zh: 这一点你的一对一辅导会非常有帮助，因为有时候很难发现自己的错误。
